Lisa,

Thanks — appreciate the clear spreadsheet. High-level answers below and we can follow with the CSV and evidence bundle:

- Baseline: Redwood's executed DPA incorporates the EU SCCs by reference for transfers from the EEA. For UK-resident personal data, we provide a UK Addendum/IDTA; customers can sign the standalone UK IDTA if required. In short: EU SCCs = included; UK IDTA = available and executed as an addendum or separate signature depending on your procurement preference.

- Signing model: We can support either: 1) DPA + attached UK Addendum that you sign as part of the DPA signature flow, or 2) a standalone UK IDTA. Procurement typically prefers the addendum path (single DocuSign transaction), but both are on the table.

- Subprocessors: I will attach our current subprocessors CSV (SCCs-mapping-Redwood.csv) with country and service type and the attestation date (2026-02-15). Note: some infra providers route ephemeral caches through non-EU PoPs for performance; we mark those rows and provide routing mitigations.

- TIAs/DTIAs: We have an evidence index (redwood-evidence-index.pdf) that maps artifacts (architecture diagrams, KV-cache controls, logging retention, HSM/KMS scope) to TIA items. I'll share a link to the evidence bundle and propose a short call with our infra/security SMEs to walk through any gaps.

Next steps I propose:
1) I'll send the CSV and evidence index by EOD today (attached).
2) Kimberly from infra will confirm which subprocessors have transitory non-EU processing and provide mitigation language.
3) If helpful, we can route you to our DocuSign page that has the DPA + UK Addendum bundled for signature.

Do any of the procurement timetables below work for a 30-min call? Thu 10:00–11:30am UK or Fri 09:00–11:00am UK.

Thanks,

> "some infra providers route ephemeral caches through non-EU PoPs for performance; we mark those rows and provide routing mitigations."

- Confirmed: prefix KV caches may be served from edge PoPs in APAC/NA for cold starts; however we offer an EU-only routing policy for customers that require strict residency. - Logs & retention: application logs are retained 90 days in the primary region; access is audited via KMS/HSM and we provide time-stamped attestations (sample: attestation_20260215.pdf).
- Subprocessor details: see SCCs-mapping-Redwood.csv — I've flagged three subprocessors (edge-cdn-1, analytics-ops, logging-queue) with transient non-EU hops. Recommended mitigations included in the CSV.
